description: The Interaction & Events block-heads `when`/`every`/`on_key`/`on_click` declared as procedures with Core Language alone: each raises `ol-reserved-word`. This is the byte-identical source its twin `block-heads-reserved-under-profile` runs with the profile ACTIVE, and both expect the same four diagnostics -- which is precisely what `spec/grammar.md:408` requires: "a program cannot declare which profiles it requires ... so a name that could be declared in one implementation but not in another would be invisible and unpredictable to a learner". It takes both fixtures to say so: either one alone is satisfied by an implementation that answers the same way for the wrong reason. **The file name is no longer true** -- these names are not "free core only" -- and renaming belongs to issue #842. `"check": true`: static legality only, nothing executes. `message` is deliberately absent from the diagnostics below: the harness strips it from BOTH sides before comparing (`scripts/harness/index.mjs:977-983` projects every diagnostic to code/span/params/stage/severity), so supplying one here would be an assertion nothing can evaluate. Diagnostic identity is `code` plus `params` and "prose is presentation" (`spec/error-model.md:253`); the learner-facing wording is pinned by unit tests instead. Its twin DOES carry `message`, and that asymmetry is intentional; dropping the decorative field from the twins is a corpus-wide edit and belongs to issue #842.
